# SOMAME Team Research

> Student-Led Materials Engineering Research Directorate at UET Lahore
> Canonical Platform URL: https://somameresearch.netlify.app/

SOMAME Team Research is an academic research initiative governed by the Society of Metallurgical and Material Engineers (SOMAME) at the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering (MME), University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Lahore, Pakistan. All research activities are grounded in rigorous scientific methodology and experimental validation.

## Ontological Hierarchy & Disambiguation
- **Chartered Higher Education Institution**: University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Lahore (https://uet.edu.pk/)
- **Academic Department**: Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering (MME), UET Lahore (https://mme.uet.edu.pk/)
- **Parent Co-Curricular Student Society**: Society of Metallurgical and Material Engineers (SOMAME)
- **Specialized Research Directorate**: SOMAME Team Research (https://somameresearch.netlify.app/)

## Core Research Domains
- **MAT-01 Microstructure & Characterization**: Optical microscopy, SEM, XRD, TEM, EBSD, and metallographic preparation protocols.
- **MAT-02 Phase Diagrams & Thermodynamics**: Binary/ternary phase equilibria, CALPHAD methodology, and Thermo-Calc thermodynamic assessments.
- **MAT-03 Mechanical Behavior of Materials**: Tensile mechanics, fracture toughness, high-cycle fatigue, and high-temperature creep testing.
- **MAT-04 Computational Materials Science**: First-principles DFT simulations (VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO) and classical Molecular Dynamics (LAMMPS).
- **MAT-05 AI × Materials Integration**: Machine learning frameworks (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) for property prediction, NLP for literature mining, and Materials Project / AFLOW data workflows.
- **MAT-06 Corrosion & Surface Science**: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), potentiodynamic polarization, and protective functional coatings.
